protocol.splitRule: Sort exact README-documented person IDs lexicographically; first three persons development, all remaining persons final. Keep every finger and scan from a person in one role. No image inspection or scores used.

matchingProtocol.pairs: All unordered image pairs within each role; genuine iff personId AND fingerId match. All other pairs are non-mated, with between-person and same-person/different-finger counts separate. Missing scores remain explicit failures.
matchingProtocol.finalAccess: No final quality, feature extraction, matching scores, or visual inspection before processing-policy freeze.

limits: Only four final persons; dependent within-finger pairs are not independent population samples.
Finger IDs are vendor identity labels; anatomical position mapping is not documented in the small README.
Person overlap with previously examined FVC/SD04 corpora is unknown. Only within-this-corpus person separation is verified.
Private local validation from official sample download; no corpus redistribution or permissive-license claim.

identityLimitation: README explicitly defines person/finger/scan IDs. Anatomical finger positions and links to previously examined FVC/SD04 persons are not documented. Subject separation is verified within this corpus only.
usageBasis: Private local validation from official sample download; no corpus-specific redistribution license is supplied. Images are not repository assets.
preparationStatus: Header, identity palette, decoded-pixel hash and exact-duplicate metadata checks only. No visual inspection, contact analysis, quality assessment, feature extraction, matching, or policy tuning.
